name: EW300
driverConfig: 1DD + 1 Planar + 1 PZT (10mm DD + 6mm annular planar + piezoelectric)
pros: Tribrid configuration at a low price
Good technical performance for the cost
cons: Can be bass-heavy for some preferences
insight: EW300 packs a dynamic, annular planar, and piezoelectric driver into an affordable tribrid. The interchangeable nozzles and energetic tuning make it a popular choice for listeners who want more complexity than a pure single-DD without spending much.
